source_update.scope: View recovery, keyboard input, tutorial and information panel behaviour in both browser editions.

keyboard_accessibility_update.scope: Command box and motion recorder shortcuts on game toolbar buttons in Full and Lite.

joint_aim_tutorial_update.scope: Step 4 teaches the selected shoulder or hip control in Full and Lite.

lead_ui_update.scope: Shared links, active motor labels, draggable limb cues and recovery hints in the hosted Full and Lite editions.

touch_input_update.scope: Shared Full and Lite touch look, tap on release and touch cancellation.

camera_choice_update.scope: Shared Full and Lite motion recorder. A named camera opens only on Start camera.

side_arm_camera_update.scope: Side-view forward arm and elbow estimates for the selected virtual arm in Full and Lite. Forward and lateral options use their respective views. Side-view takes store outcomes by side, with camera-off playback via the Command box.

side_leg_camera_update.scope: Side-view targets for the selected virtual hip, knee and ankle in Full and Lite. Supports live camera, local video and timed pictures. Only accepted joints supply movement. Save and replay through the Command box with the camera off.

movement_mirror_side_view_update.scope: Side-view body choices in the Movement mirror from the same images as NeuroTranslate 0.0 point forecasts. The current forecast uses independent coordinate evidence, and its history survives body selection changes.

finger_camera_update.scope: Player and mirror digit bend targets. Physical-device timing and accuracy need separate validation.

wrist_recovery_update.scope: Optional same-frame recovery for missing fingers in Recorder and Movement forecast
